description: Hash text with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, CRC32, Whirlpool, SHA3-256, SHA3-512 or BLAKE2b-256 and answer the digest in hex, or for crc32 as an integer. Use sha256, sha3_256 or blake2b for integrity checks; md5 and sha1 are for systems that still expect them. None of these is a password hash. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.
